summary: Undetectable volume. Ultra-lightweight, tapered false lashes designed to seamlessly integrate with your natural lash line.
description: Aesthetic extension engineering. Utilizing synthetic silk fibers on an invisible, flexible band, these lashes provide dimensional length and density with zero structural weight or irritation.
technical_overview: Offered at $18.0 for 1 Pair, this KoColor FALSE_LASHES is expertly crafted with Synthetic Silk Fibers and a Polyurethane Band. It delivers a high-fidelity Vantablack color profile (`#000000`) and leverages micro-tapered fiber technology.

dynamic_attributes.label: Usage Notes
dynamic_attributes.body: Trim the band from the outer corner to fit your eye shape before applying with structural adhesive.

dynamic_attributes.label: Expert Tip
dynamic_attributes.body: Wrap the lash band around a makeup brush handle for 30 seconds before application to enforce the curve.

dynamic_attributes.label: Formulation Insight
dynamic_attributes.body: Fibers are individually tapered at the ends to mimic the biological growth pattern of human hair.
